cross_cutting_findings: config/historical_datasets/EURUSD_H1_202501020000_202607310000.yaml and GBPUSD_H1_symbol_metadata.yaml both declare a wider ~19-month H1 history, but their source_file fields point to D:\\EURUSD_H1_...csv / D:\\GBPUSD...csv on the project owner's Windows host -- those bytes are NOT present in this git checkout. This mission could not use them and does not claim to have validated them.

docs/status/AG_EXTERNAL_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_LAYER_V1_STATUS.md and docs/specs/AG_RESEARCH_FACTORY_V1_GOVERNANCE_SPEC.md both describe a `src/external_candidate/` package (admission, parity, OOS/walk-forward, friction, evidence envelope) and a `performance/` package (calculator, cost_model, models) as already built and tested. Neither physically exists anywhere in this repository's git history on any branch reachable from this checkout (`git log --all -- src/external_candidate` returns nothing; no directory named `performance` exists under `src/` or elsewhere; `scripts/generate_economic_evidence_report.py` and `research_external/run_s2r_baseline.py` both fail today with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'performance'`). This mission does not attempt to resurrect or silently reimplement that package under its old name; the small `replay/common.py` and `replay/friction.py` modules built for this mission are intentionally scoped, new, and separately named.
